Exact tracker title observed

Power to the Bench

Exact tracker title observed

A five-objective utility tutorial that connects City Hall, Victor's contract and the ranch workbench.

  • The exact tracker title and five-objective route were observed on Day 8 in current-build footage. Video-observed

    Source: Games Station current-build gameplay archive and tracker frames · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.455

  • The observed route sends the player to City Hall and Victor to commission an electricity and gas contract before building the workbench. Video-observed

    Source: Games Station current-build gameplay archive and tracker frames · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.455

    Source: Games Station current-build gameplay archive and tracker frames · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.455

Chicken Coop Mission

Community label

Community label for the early chicken-purchase objective; the exact in-game tracker title is not retained.

  • Players complete the purchase step through Angela, the chicken seller. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Bought chickens spawn in the fenced field behind her house instead of entering inventory; grab them and use a car boot or carry them home. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Every retained stuck case came from missing the post-purchase prompt, but that pattern does not rule out other mission bugs. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · Build: 0.8.10.x

Roof-building tutorial objective

Descriptive name

A descriptive entry for the roof-building objective because the exact tracker title is not retained.

  • Official support confirmed a known state where the roof objective is built but its tracker does not advance. Official

    Source: Steam thread: roof tracker known issue and support sequence · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • The official recovery sequence is to inspect the phone quest journal with T, sleep to the next day and restart the client if the tracker remains stuck. Official

    Source: Steam thread: roof tracker known issue and support sequence · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Separate community cases involve hidden workbench rows, missing door/window placement or a Roof Cap opening; use the decision guide instead of treating every symptom as the tracker bug. Community-confirmed

    Source: August 2026 roof-building discussion scan · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

Real Eggs, Real Evidence

Current community title

The current large-egg route involving Gigi, a police escape and the present end of the implemented quest line.

  • The retained current route requires two Large Eggs; daily care and enclosed outdoor roaming affect the chance, but the result remains random. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Real Eggs, Real Evidence · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • After handoff, Gigi follows the player during a police escape and must be returned to her home area to complete the documented route. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Real Eggs, Real Evidence · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Multiple players report no implemented follow-up after the return; waiting additional seasons is not a verified solution. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: current quest line after Real Eggs · Build: 0.8.10.x

Solar panel objective

Community label

Community label for the objective that distinguishes the basic ground panel from the roof version.

  • Two players independently confirmed that the objective needs the basic ground solar panel. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Solar Panel Quest · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • The roof solar panel does not satisfy this objective even though it is also a solar panel. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Solar Panel Quest · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • The retained confirmations say one correctly placed ground panel is sufficient; exact quest title and prerequisite timing remain unverified. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Solar Panel Quest · Build: 0.8.10.x
